slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The EU AI Act will begin enforcement on August 2
The act aims to regulate the use of AI in the EU
With a focus on transparency, accountability, and safety
The enforcement will impact companies operating in the EU, with potential fines of up to €20 million or 4% of global turnover

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The EU AI Act is a significant step towards regulating AI
The enforcement will have far-reaching implications for companies operating in the EU
Companies must ensure compliance with the act to avoid potential fines
